title: Video: Celegene, CES and Everything You Need to Know Monday
text:
Here's everything you need to know before Monday's opening bell:  

Celgene ( CELG ) agreed to buy Impact Biomedicines for as much as $7 billion.  Apple ( AAPL ) has been urged to take action to curb growing smartphone addiction among children.  Driverless cars steal the show at the first day of CES in Las Vegas. Dunkin' ( DNKN ) will roll out its streamlined menu at all U.S. locations by mid-March. U.S. stock futures suggest Wall Street's strong start to the new year will continue. Watch More with TheStreet :
